roleInfo.description: You hate taking points, and you always play to win 😎

Default.inAMomentTell: ($1) - in a moment, tell me whether you want Ludio to teach your group how to play this game!
Default.whoNeedsTheTutorial: ($1), who needs the tutorial? Click on the players or select from the middle.
Default.toGetRidOf: To get rid of a card, the card you just played must stay on the board until it’s your turn again.
Default.cardsOfTheSame: Cards of the same rank get added together.
Default.andTheirPreviousCard: ... AND their previous card stayed on the board, so their card gets removed from the board without getting replaced, along with any cards of the same rank.
Default.thereAreNowMultiple: There are now multiple copies of this card...
Default.onTheBoardSo: ... on the board, so they get added together and will immediately eat anything with a lower rank.
